column1: # FP support assets, bound to the PINNED GIT OBJECT at 9bb41a09d6b57111ed2b3fd10102ec4ff174b6c6.
# These are not in the 56-asset baseline, so an earlier version of this
# file recorded only observed working-tree hashes -- which verify nothing,
# since the observation and the copy came from the same bytes. The blob id
# and its content hash come from `git rev-parse <pin>:<path>` and
# `git cat-file`, so `verified` means the installed file equals the object
# the pin names. `untracked_at_pin` means git does not have it there and
# the row is an observation, stated as one.
